full_prompt_en: A close oil-painted scene shows a young, dark-haired figure leaning at a low stone ledge in a dim interior. The figure occupies most of the square frame, turned three-quarters toward the left and looking upward beyond the picture with a grave, absorbed expression. A bent arm rises from the lower left; the hand supports the chin, while the other forearm rests near the ledge along the bottom. Thick, rust-red drapery crosses the near shoulder and gathers into large, weighty folds across the right side of the image. A subdued olive garment appears beneath the red cloth around the torso and sleeve. Behind the figure is a broad, warm charcoal-brown wall, nearly featureless and dark enough for the illuminated face, forearm, and cloth to emerge clearly. The face has warm ivory and ochre halftones, a defined nose and brow, and soft transitions into the dark curls. The exposed forearm has a rounded, sculptural presence, with strong but gradual changes from light to shadow. The red fabric carries more visible angular folds and dark creases, its brighter ridges catching the same directional light. Light enters from the upper left, concentrating on the cheek, forehead, and lifted arm before weakening across the shoulders and falling away into the background. Deep umber, near black, muted olive, skin-toned gold, and earthy vermilion create rich but controlled contrast. The surface shows layered oil paint: smooth blending in flesh, slightly more emphatic brush structure in the drapery, and a softly rubbed, dark ground. The composition is compact and emotionally restrained, with the upturned gaze and diagonal line of the supporting arm guiding the eye through the picture. Dense Baroque chiaroscuro fills the frame, with warm forms emerging from enveloping darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅近距离油画场景呈现一位深发年轻人物倚在昏暗室内的低矮石质台沿。人物占据方形画面的大部分，以四分之三侧身朝左，目光越过画面向上望去，表情严肃而专注。一只弯起的手臂从左下方抬起，手掌托住下巴；另一只前臂则靠在底部的台沿附近。厚重的铁锈红色织物越过靠近观者的肩头，在画面右侧聚成大块而沉重的褶皱。躯干和袖子周围，红布下露出暗淡的橄榄绿色衣物。人物背后是一面宽阔的暖炭褐色墙面，几乎没有细节，深度足以衬出受光的面孔、前臂与衣料。温暖象牙白与赭黄中间调塑造面部，鼻子和眉骨清晰，与深色卷发柔和相接。裸露前臂具有圆润的雕塑感，明暗变化强烈而渐进。红色织物的折线更显棱角，暗褶清楚，较亮的隆起处承接同一方向的光。光从左上方进入，集中照亮面颊、额头和抬起的手臂，然后沿肩部减弱并消失在背景里。色彩使用深赭褐、近黑、灰暗橄榄绿、带金色的肤色和泥土感朱红，形成浓厚但受控的对比。表面呈现层叠油彩：肌肤处平滑融合，衣褶处笔触结构略为鲜明，深色底面则像被柔和擦拭过。构图紧凑，情绪克制，上望视线与支撑手臂的斜线引导目光穿过画面。整幅画面保持浓密的巴洛克式明暗对照，使温暖的形体从包围它的黑暗中浮现。
style_prompt_en: Layered oil painting with dense chiaroscuro and warm, earthy color. Rounded forms emerge through gradual transitions of ivory, ochre, and umber, with illuminated planes appearing from a near-black ground. Strong directional light from the upper left concentrates the brightest passages in a compact focal area; edges and background recede into broad shadow. The controlled palette contains rust red, muted olive, warm gold, charcoal brown, and blackened umber. Broad angular folds, dark creases, and warm highlights give pliable surfaces a heavy, tactile quality. Smoother blended passages meet evident brushwork, giving the material the depth and slight irregularity of layered paint. A close, weighty composition has a diagonal internal rhythm and restrained movement, giving the image a dramatic yet quiet atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠油画技法、浓密的明暗对照和温暖的泥土色系。象牙白、赭黄与赭褐的渐变形成圆润体积，受光平面从近黑底面浮现。左上方强定向光照亮画面，最亮部分集中在紧凑视觉焦点，其余边缘与背景退入大片阴影。色彩控制在铁锈红、灰暗橄榄绿、暖金色、炭褐和发黑的赭褐之间。宽阔有棱角的褶皱、深色折缝与温暖高光，赋予柔韧表面厚重质感。较平滑的融合区域与更可见的笔触相接，使材质具有层叠颜料的深度和轻微不规则感。构图偏近景且有分量，内部节奏呈斜向，动作表达克制；整体充满戏剧性，同时保持安静。
theme_en: A contemplative figure in red drapery
theme_zh: 披着红色织物的沉思人物
name: Guercino
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
